name: AI Data Remover – SEO Cleanup Tool
author: Jordan Alexander

sections.description:
AI Data Remover scans your WordPress content and removes data-* attributes that bloat HTML, hurt SEO, and are commonly injected by AI tools, page builders, and copy/paste operations.

This helps:
* Reduce DOM size
* Improve Core Web Vitals
* Clean page builder markup
* Improve crawl efficiency

Free version includes:
* Posts & Pages
* Scan up to 500 items
* Remove up to 25 at once
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via WordPress Admin → Plugins
  3. Go to AI Data Remover in the admin menu
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Code quality: use proper admin enqueues for JS/CSS.
  • Compatibility: prefix all functions/classes/options to avoid conflicts.

1.0.0

Initial release.
